answer.origin: NVIDIA Corporation, company blog statement dated 2026-07-01 (publication and stated event date).
answer.note: NVIDIA says it is introducing a model in which AI clouds can procure NVIDIA infrastructure with revenue sharing and credit support, sell NVIDIA-powered cloud services, and generate both standard product revenue and a share of cloud revenue for NVIDIA on supported capacity (incoming). NVIDIA characterizes the latter as a recurring, usage-linked earnings stream; this supports a potential additional monetization channel, conditional on the model being implemented and supported capacity generating cloud revenue. The article also says AI cloud companies are building DSX AI factories (item:e3); Sharon AI’s CEO describes a collaboration with NVIDIA (item:e2); and Firmus is building a Batam campus expected to scale to 360 MW and up to 170,000 NVIDIA GPUs (item:e4). These are relevant signs of prospective infrastructure supply and ecosystem activity, but the stated capacity is an expectation, not evidence of deployed GPUs or NVIDIA orders. The article identifies AI-native cloud customers and their needs, which is demand context, not evidence of their purchases or NVIDIA revenue. The statement does not establish that every described build or collaboration uses the new commercial model, or that any particular capacity is contracted under it.
limitations: The article does not disclose the model’s revenue-share, credit-support, or other contract terms, nor the amount or timing of revenue attributable to it.
It does not identify signed agreements, supported capacity, deployment schedules, utilization, or the extent to which the model is in operation.
The article does not establish that Firmus’s stated campus capacity, or Sharon AI’s collaboration, is financed or contracted through this model; it also gives no NVIDIA order value for either.
The named AI-native companies and their described compute needs do not establish orders, customer commitments, or resulting NVIDIA revenue.
follow_up: Check NVIDIA filings and subsequent company announcements for executed AI-cloud agreements, disclosed supported capacity, and revenue-share or credit-support economics.
Track NVIDIA and partner updates for deployment, utilization, and procurement milestones at the Firmus Batam campus and any disclosed link to this model.
Check named AI-native cloud companies’ filings or announcements for capacity commitments or deployments that would evidence realized demand, rather than stated need.
